title: Tamsin and the House
author: Emrys Delacroix
blurb: Rafael Nystrom, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
